Game Overview

At its heart, Stick Santa is a hyper-casual game about guide Santa across snowy chasms by crafting the perfect length sticks in a charming winter wonderland. Balance accuracy and timing to keep Santa safe from plummeting below. Will you master the delicate art of precision, ensuring Santa's smooth holiday journey, or face the challenges of tricky terrain?
